nameEn: Retail sale of flowers, plants, seeds, fertilizers, pet animals and pet food in specialised stores
description: This class includes the retail sale of flowers, plants, seeds, pets and pet supplies in specialised stores.
includes: retail sale of cut flowers and plants
retail sale of seeds, fertilizers, garden soil
retail sale of pet animals: dogs, cats, fish, birds
retail sale of pet food and pet supplies
retail sale of aquarium fish and supplies
retail sale of live Christmas trees
excludes: agricultural production of plants and seeds, see 011x
